key_findings.finding: A separate Parmelia sulcata study evaluated a nanosilver formulation made from a phenolic P. sulcata extract (Ps-AgNPs) in MCF-7 breast-cancer cells, with NIH3T3 normal cells as comparator. It reported selective cytotoxicity/apoptosis in MCF-7 and western-blot evidence consistent with an intrinsic apoptotic pathway, including down-regulation of TNF-α, IL-6, PCNA, and Cyclin-D1. The accessible abstract gives no Ps-AgNP concentration, exposure time, Annexin V/caspase/PARP result, or direct DNA-damage assay, so it supports apoptosis-related activity but not DNA damage. PMID: 34048745.
